messages:
anya: Thanks all for the all-hands. Quick follow-ups re: runtime roadmap — two quick asks: 1) what's the timeline for kernel rewrite v2 landing in Dedicated? 2) any recommended batching/cache defaults for low-latency chat (<=120ms p50) at 2-4 token bursts? Leaving a small config we tried below. TL;DR: guidance needed for canary next week.

samir: Short answer — kernel v2 targeted for a limited Dedicated canary next month, GA ~8 weeks after canary assuming no regressions. We'll drop the rollout plan + risk matrix tomorrow. cc: @leo

leo: Priorities are attention-kernel opt + KV cache refactor. For low-latency chat try: batch_size=8, max_latency_ms=30, prewarm_kv=true. These settings hit p50 targets in our sim runs. Will publish a tuning script.

anya: Thanks — two quick clarifications: a) when you say prewarm_kv=true, what's the memory impact? b) what's the automated fallback if canary regresses perf?

leo: prewarm_kv typically raises resident mem ~6-12% depending on model & seq length. Tradeoff: much higher KV hit rate -> lower token latency. Fallback: canary policy will auto-toggle to v1 kernel + smaller batch size; we also have a quick config rollback playbook.

diana: For the canary run ops will need a checklist. @mike can you confirm the SLOs/metrics ops should monitor?

mike: I'll push a minimal dashboard this afternoon: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU util, OOM count, error rate, and KV hit ratio. Also adding a synthetic load script. ETA EOD.

samir: Perf tip — microbatching helps a lot for bursty real-time. Consider microbatch_window_ms=5. Sample config we used: 
```yaml
batching:
  enabled: true
  microbatch_window_ms: 5
  max_batch_size: 8
cache:
  kv_prewarm: true
  eviction_policy: lru
```

anya: Awesome. Any suggestions for fallbacks when we see latency spikes from batching? We saw a ~300ms spike in a dev canary once.

leo: If you see spikes: 1) reduce microbatch_window_ms, 2) reduce max_batch_size, 3) if still bad, route tail/tiny requests to a low-latency pool (policy: latency-first). Also watch for head-of-line blocking in the request router.

diana: Ops note: during the canary, please tag traces with `canary:kernel-v2` and include the `batch_config` in metadata. We'll need those for the postmortem if anything odd shows up.

anya: Will do. One last ask — is there a canonical docs link for the rollout playbook?

mike: Published: https://redwood.internal/docs/runtime/canary-playbook (internal). :tada:

infra-bot: deploy job #4728 queued for canary cluster (kernel-v2). ETA 02:00 UTC.

anya: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll compile these items into the canary run checklist and ping the SRE on call.
